prompt.role: A voice that sounds like the finance lead
prompt.text: The voice is right. The hurry is right. They want a payment released before the bank closes, and they tell you not to call back because they are walking into a board meeting.

choices.label: Release the payment
choices.debrief: A familiar voice is not a second factor.
choices.report: A payment went out on a phone call.
choices.voice_line: You released a payment because the voice sounded right.

fallout.text: The payment lands in an account the finance lead has never used. The real lead was in the meeting, with the phone face down.

choices.label: Hang up and call the finance lead on the number the company has
choices.debrief: You called the number on file. The person in the meeting did not make the first call.
choices.bark: You called back on the known number.
choices.report: The payment waited for the number the company already has.
choices.voice_line: You hung up and called the number the company has.

choices.label: Text the number that just called and ask them to confirm
choices.debrief: That number is the caller. Confirming with them confirms nothing.
choices.report: The confirmation went back to the caller.
choices.voice_line: You asked the same number to confirm itself.

fallout.text: They confirm. The payment still leaves.

draft_note: Same skill as the Monday wire call: known number, not the one that contacted you.
